name: The Horror Mystery ~Sangekikan Kevin Hakushaku no Fukkatsu~
original_name: THE ホラーミステリー 〜惨劇館 ケビン伯爵の復活〜
source:
Simple 1500 Series vol.074 The Horror Mystery The Sangeki Yakata Cabin Hakushaku no Fukkatsu is an adventure game in which the player controls a character that arrives to a small town and there he will meet different kind of people but soon he will discover that that small town got some secrets hidden, some of them are deadly dangerous.

In the game the player will advance through 13 chapters choosing different answers that will leave him to different game endings (some of them are bad endings) so the player have to choose carefully is he wants to advance and complete the game.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/S/SLPM-86901.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
《THE恐怖悬疑 ～惨剧馆 凯文伯爵的复活～》是Simple 1500系列第74作，也是一款冒险游戏。玩家操控的角色来到一座小镇，在这里结识形形色色的人，却很快发现，这座小镇隐藏着许多秘密，其中一些甚至足以致命。

玩家将通过选择不同回答，推进全13章的故事，并迎来各种结局，其中也包括坏结局。想要顺利推进并完成游戏，就必须谨慎选择。

[摘自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/S/SLPM-86901.html]PSX Data Center[/url]]
